subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence

Last week's rain **__ravaged__** the whole city.
solution: The correct answer is: **Ruined** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Ravaged **means to cause severe damage or destruction. (गंभीर क्षति या विनाश करना) • **For example**: *The tornado ravaged the small town, leaving behind destruction.* • Marked option **Ruined **means to damage something so badly that it loses all its value, pleasure, etc. (किसी चीज़ को तबाह कर देना, बरबाद कर देना) • **For example**: *The fire completely ruined the historic building.* • So, 'ruined' is the best **synonym **for "ravaged" in this context. • The past tense form of "ruin" is "ruined", which fits perfectly in the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Reaffirmed **means to confirm or assert again. It does not fit the context of the sentence. (दोबारा पुष्टि या दावा करना) • **Rescinded **means to revoke or cancel. It does not fit the context of the sentence. (रद्द करना) • **Retracted **means to withdraw or take back. It does not fit the context of the sentence. (वापस लेना) 35:Tc30, শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ হ'ল: **ধ্বংস কৰিলে**
